verdict.rationale: AngelList Equity documents its own ASC 718 Analysis Report, which uses a Black-Scholes model to give grant- and tranche-level breakdowns, and its reports export to Excel. The report is gated to the Scale Plan, and nothing shows it is audit-ready. The help center also describes helping customers move to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which raises doubt about whether the capability will remain available. missing for 10: evidence that the output is auditor-ready (e.g., journal entries, expense period reporting, audit trail), availability below the Scale Plan, clarity on the product's ongoing availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors

citations.quote: ASC 718 Analysis Report: Available in Scale Plan, a report that uses a Black-Scholes model ... to provide grant & tranche level breakdowns
AngelList Equity offers many reports available for export to Excel from your cap table.
